message:
[refactor] Start using match case in 'assertrepr_compare' (#13762)

Replace the if/elif dispatch on ``op`` with a ``match``/``case`` on
``(left, op, right)``. The ``str()`` and ``AbstractSet()`` class
patterns subsume the ``istext`` / ``isset`` guards that the if/elif
form needed alongside the operator check.

Co-authored-by: Claude Opus 5 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>
